overview_description.description:
Sick of going to hundreds of different sites to shop for clothes, home decor, and gifts? Autumn lets you browse across thousands of stores by just swiping—it's like Tinder for shopping!

As you swipe, the app learns what you like and recommends more items and stores that match your style.

You can find over 5,000 stores in the app from Zara, West Elm, to local boutiques—this means all of your favorite stores are in one place, making it easy to compare items and keep track of new arrivals and sales.
